what: The world-building caption in play, a Start clicked before the world was built (chunk meshes held 12 s after the lock), production build, Chromium new headless on Apple M3 Max (ANGLE Metal), 1280x800 at DPR 2. fg: median of glyph pixels within RGB distance 48 of the CSS colour; bg: median of a ring 2-6 CSS px outside the text box; worst: against the ring pixel at the 10th percentile of luminance distance. WCAG 2 relative luminance. Frames: caption-before.jpg, caption-after.jpg (downscaled to 1280 wide).
